question.problem: Given that $X∼\text{Geom}(\frac{1}{7}),$ compute $P(5\le X<8)$ rounded to $4$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(\frac{1}{7}),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}{(\frac{6}{7})}^{x-1}(\frac{1}{7}), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(5\le X<8) & =P(X\in \{5,6,7\}) \\  & =P(X=5)+P(X=6)+P(X=7) \\  & =f(5)+f(6)+f(7) \\  & ={(\frac{6}{7})}^{4}(\frac{1}{7})+{(\frac{6}{7})}^{5}(\frac{1}{7})+{(\frac{6}{7})}^{6}(\frac{1}{7}) \\  & ≈0.1999.\end{aligned}
$$
